# Summary and Questions
In the post we discuss whether the TFIM has supermacy or have universal quantum compuating power.


## TFIM supermacy

The TFIM circuit $P(s) = |\bra{s} U_{\rm TFIM} \ket{0^n}| ,\, U_{\rm tot}=U_R U_{\rm TFIM}(T) U_L$, where $U_{\rm TFIM}(t)$ follows the time-dependent Hamiltonian:
$$
\begin{align*}
H(t)&=\Gamma(t)H_X+H_Z+h_z(t)\sum_i Z_i , \\
H_X &= \sum_{i \in {V}} X_i, \quad H_I = \sum_{i \in \mathcal{V}_{\mathcal{H}}} v_i Z_i +\sum_{(i,j)\in {E}} J_{ij} Z_iZ_j,
\end{align*}
$$
where the graph $(v,E)$ is fixed with fixed parameters $v_i, J_{ij}$.
The time-dependent parameters $\Gamma(t), h_z(t)$ are controllable.
